review: All exact consumers retargeted. Country branch and pair array stop masquerading as objectives; the geofence composite retains their observations with explicit country-branch exit evidence.

The bare ErrorActionPreference assignment ceases to satisfy any testing-directory selector; stop-on-error is not CI or testing provenance. The real CI exception retains the observation explicitly alongside CI path, verification basename, and runner temp evidence.

History path query leaves fs/read selectors because it does not read history-file bytes. Broad fs remains; personal-path consumers now see its actual subject. The read umbrella consumer is JavaScript-only.
PSReadLine mode control leaves environment-variable selectors; its two explicit hostile consumers retain the mode fact.

Payload execution leaves legacy C2/dropper selectors and joins execution/payload. The legacy broad selectors found were ELF-oriented installer/dropper profiles or a CrystalX family context; none establishes a PowerShell command channel.

URL moves preserve exact exclusions and consumers. The encoded-URL broad selector selects actual encoded URL findings for a JavaScript bundle context; an inline data-image URI does not prove an encoded URL. The pair of Microsoft documentation exclusions remains identical in population.

The host/name leaf and payload/file-exec leaf were each at 100. Semantic review identified an existing pipe-delimited token list that proves no hostname and a serialized JSON argument atom that proves no activation or attack context; moved those two atoms without changing matcher/scope/severity. Their cloaking and serialized-tool-request composites retain exact explicit references. Existing packed-cloak and stored attack-request positives are tested.

BaseNamedObjects namespace now admits Windows-applicable source/binary groups and Python. A disjoint Python call matcher adds CreateFileTransacted coverage; the native symbol matcher retains its original scope and pattern. Existing hostile consumers have additional operation context and most retain native-only scopes; new observations do not independently establish escalation. The transaction composite still requires CommitTransaction.

Existing geogated WebClient consumer is unchanged. Current facts project New-Object arguments as arrays; its pre-existing string-argument matcher misses the control. This is an existing engine/matcher gap, not removed attack coverage.
